bugCost.title: Cost of Finding a Bug by Development Stage
bugCost.subtitle: The later a bug is caught, the exponentially more expensive it is to fix. With our QA services, you catch defects at the earliest and cheapest stage.
bugCost.devDesc: Developer catches the bug in their IDE or unit test while writing code — takes minutes to fix and is practically free ($1).
bugCost.testDesc: QA engineer catches the bug through structured test cases — takes a brief cycle, but product is not yet in customer hands ($10).
bugCost.uatDesc: Client or PM discovers bug during acceptance check — requires hot rework, delayed launch, and redeployment ($100).
bugCost.prodDesc: End users experience the defect live — revenue loss, brand reputation damage, user churn, and costly emergency fixes ($1000).
bugCost.multiplierDesc: 1 critical production flaw can cost businesses tens of thousands of dollars in damage.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Text: TestingHub strictly respects the privacy of our platform users and the confidentiality of client intellectual property. This Privacy Policy outlines what information we collect, how it is processed, and our robust security protocols.
privacy.sec2Text: We only collect minimal data required to render QA services, process calculator inquiries, and communicate with clients: name, phone number, email, company name, and project scope specifications.
privacy.sec3Text: All client software, repositories, API credentials, test datasets, and proprietary business logic are safeguarded under strict Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA). Disclosing data to third parties is strictly prohibited.
privacy.sec4Text: To provide optimal user experience, save preferred language (uz, ru, en), and maintain theme preferences (dark/light), secure local storage and cookie mechanisms are utilized.
privacy.sec5Text: You have the right to request deletion or modification of your data at any time. For questions, contact our security officer: privacy@testinghub.uz
